objective: Upgrade Revision C into a wheeled bimanual household robot with two seven-axis arms, a liftable torso, shared-workspace interlocks, quick-change tools, and a premium product visual grounded in public dual-arm mobile-manipulator references.
acceptance: Revision D declares two arms and seven revolute joints per arm
the lift and mobile base dimensions are compatible with a 1100-1450 mm working height and indoor doorway footprint
left-only, right-only, shared bimanual, and forbidden interference volumes are explicit
SCAD and CadQuery depict two coherent seven-axis arms attached to the lift-supported structural torso
the product visual shows both arms in a physically plausible bimanual parcel pose with enclosed wheels
cooking remains supervised induction-only assistance pending thermal and force validation
mechanical tests, Ruff, and Task Packet validation pass
stop_conditions: a change requires robot control, firmware, interfaces, or PCB ownership
the concept would claim autonomous open-flame cooking, stairs, person lifting, or certified payload performance
dual-arm interference or lift stability evidence would need to be invented
the visual cannot show both arms connected to a credible structural shoulder
